fast.change: Added optional filters (ignore_patterns, include_tests), binary file detection, and returns a secondary list of file paths.
fast.impact: Changes function signature and return type, potentially breaking existing callers expecting a single dictionary.

detailed.change: The function signature now accepts two new parameters: ignore_patterns and include_tests, allowing callers to refine the crawl scope. Logic was added to preemptively skip binary files via is_binary and filter out test-related files based on naming conventions. Additionally, the function now returns a tuple (dict, list) instead of just the original dictionary, exposing the accumulated file path list.
detailed.impact: This update makes the analysis more efficient by reducing IO overhead for non-text files and irrelevant test artifacts. However, because the return type has shifted from a flat dictionary to a tuple, any downstream code consuming the return value of analyze_project will likely raise an unpack error or type mismatch, requiring immediate refactoring of the calling codebase.
detailed.risk: The modification of the return signature introduces a breaking change that will cause runtime crashes for all existing consumers of this function. While the logic improvements for filtering are valuable, the lack of backward compatibility necessitates a high severity rating. high
